item: Server caveats, methods and reasons read in the page's language, or say they are English (row 206, part 1)
summary: said(field, template, **values) sends a server sentence's English beside one keyed frame; the page renders it with ooSaidHtml/ooSaidText (app-core.js), which renders the frame, looks up a keyed constant, and otherwise shows the English behind the visible 'Server text, in English' label (R289) -- a frame whose template the page's locale lacks is labelled too. Every raw print of a server caveat, method or reason in the app pages (esc(x.f), esc(x.f || ""), el.title = x.f; 83 calls in 13 files) goes through it; 8 page-built sites and the standalone reader page's 4 (no app-core.js there; remaining) are listed with a reason, zero slack. Every said() template is a key in 12 languages (AST test). Keyed x12 in this part: backup verify method, the AI hardware caveat, the statistics directory, ingest, subscriptions, triangulation, revision-anomaly method and caveat, the series comparability caveat. Limits: text drawn translated follows a language switch when its surface redraws (the walker cannot re-translate it); sentences sent through t() are keyed lookups and not counted. The first draft named the helper ooServerText, which app-core.js already declares; a single-declaration test pins the three names.
